description:
Create a new purchase order in the Purchases module of ServiceDesk Plus. 

Goal: Create a PO for 'Network Infrastructure - Office Buildout Phase 1' from vendor 'Cisco Systems' due on 06/30/2025.

Required Details:
1. Navigate to Purchases > New Purchase Order
2. Name: 'Network Infrastructure - Office Buildout Phase 1'
3. Vendor: 'Cisco Systems'
4. Due Date: 06/30/2025
5. Add Line Item 1: 'Cisco Catalyst 9200-48P Switch', Quantity: 10, Unit Price: 4250.00
6. Add Line Item 2: 'Cisco Meraki MR46 Access Point', Quantity: 5, Unit Price: 1150.00
7. Save the Purchase Order.

Note: The login credentials are administrator / administrator.
